title: Did Iran Come Out on Top in the Peace Deal?

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带着 300 件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把 DJ 台变成一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittreweff.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特鲁夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Sunday, we reached an agreement with Iran that achieves everything we set out to accomplish, everything and much more.
sentences.zh: 周日，我们与伊朗达成了一项协议，实现了我们设定的所有目标，一切目标，甚至更多。

sentences.en: After the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国

sentences.en: and Iran signed a deal to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz this week, the Trump administration touted it as a huge victory.
sentences.zh: 与伊朗本周签署协议结束战争并重新开放霍尔木兹海峡后，特朗普政府将其吹捧为一场巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: We and the broader region win.
sentences.zh: 我们和整个地区都赢了。

sentences.en: Iran is weakened, their nuclear program destroyed, their economy in desperate straits.
sentences.zh: 伊朗被削弱了，他们的核计划被摧毁了，经济陷入了绝境。

sentences.en: But when the actual terms of the agreement became public...
sentences.zh: 但当协议的具体条款公布时……

sentences.en: This will go down as a tremendous foreign policy blunder.
sentences.zh: 这将被载入史册，成为一次极其严重的外交政策失误。

sentences.en: It prompted a wave of criticism from lawmakers in both parties about what exactly the Trump administration had given up.
sentences.zh: 这引发了国会两党议员的一波批评，质疑特朗普政府到底放弃了什么。

sentences.en: It's not even comparable to the Obama deal.
sentences.zh: 这甚至无法与奥巴马时期的协议相提并论。

sentences.en: It's worse by a lot.
sentences.zh: 它差得远了。

sentences.en: Iran ends up stronger.
sentences.zh: 伊朗反而变得更强大了。

sentences.en: Our allies in the region are weaker.
sentences.zh: 我们在该地区的盟友变得更弱了。

sentences.en: There's no specific commitment to the verifiable dismantling of their nuclear weapons program.
sentences.zh: 协议中没有关于可核查地拆除其核武器计划的具体承诺。

sentences.en: History demonstrates that giving billions of dollars to theocratic lunatics who want to murder us is an exceptionally bad idea.
sentences.zh: 历史证明，给那些想要谋杀我们的神权疯子数十亿美元是一个极其糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: I think it's a deep mistake.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个深刻的错误。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague David Sanger explains what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·桑格将解释美国

sentences.en: gets out of the deal and just how much Iran stands to gain.
sentences.zh: 从这份协议中得到了什么，以及伊朗将获得多少利益。

sentences.en: It's Friday, June 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 6 月 19 日，星期五。

sentences.en: David, hello again.
sentences.zh: 大卫，你好。

sentences.en: At this point, it feels like you are on The Daily almost every other day.
sentences.zh: 现在感觉你几乎每隔一天就会出现在《每日新闻》上。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for giving us so much of your time.
sentences.zh: 所以非常感谢你抽出这么多时间。

sentences.en: Great to be with you, Natalie, as always.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你在一起，娜塔莉，一如既往。

sentences.en: We talked to you earlier in the week when we learned that we had a deal to end this war, which at that point no one had actually seen.
sentences.zh: 我们本周早些时候谈过，当时我们得知达成了一项结束这场战争的协议，但那时还没有人真正看到协议内容。

sentences.en: And then on Wednesday, the Trump administration came out with the details of what was actually in it.
sentences.zh: 然后周三，特朗普政府公布了协议的实际细节。

sentences.en: And I think it's fair to say that those details elicited a very big reaction in lots of interesting ways, which we want to get into.
sentences.zh: 我认为可以公平地说，这些细节以许多有趣的方式引发了巨大的反响，我们想深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: But first, what is in this deal?
sentences.zh: 但首先，这份协议里到底有什么？

sentences.en: Start with what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 先从美国

sentences.en: got.
sentences.zh: 得到了什么说起吧。

sentences.en: Well, the main thing that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，美国得到的主要东西，娜塔莉，是战争中 60 天的停火，以及某种程度上回到美国

sentences.en: got, Natalie, was a 60-day ceasefire in the war and sort of a return to the status quo, at least for a little while, that existed before the U.S.
sentences.zh: 和以色列袭击伊朗之前存在的那种现状，至少暂时是这样。

sentences.en: and Israel attacked Iran.
sentences.zh: 但关键要知道的是，它并没有真正解决导致总统和内塔尼亚胡总理袭击伊朗的任何问题。

sentences.en: But the key thing to know is that it didn't really address any of the issues that led the president and Prime Minister Netanyahu to attack Iran.
sentences.zh: 它只是重置了时钟。

sentences.en: It just sort of resets the clock.
sentences.zh: 而且它只有一段话涉及这场战争的根本原因，即伊朗的核计划。

sentences.en: And it has one paragraph on what was the underlying cause of this war, which is Iran's nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 那它对该计划是怎么说的？

sentences.en: And what does it say about the program?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是唯一一段真正对伊朗提出明确义务的段落。

sentences.en: Well, this is the only paragraph that actually puts an affirmative obligation on Iran.
sentences.zh: 让我为你读一部分，娜塔莉，因为我觉得你会明白它的意思。

sentences.en: And let me read part of it to you, Natalie, because I think you'll get a sense of it.
sentences.zh: 第一句话说，

sentences.en: The first sentence says,
sentences.zh: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国重申，它不会获取或开发核武器。

sentences.en: The Islamic Republic of Iran reaffirms that it shall not procure or develop nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 现在，总统一直在大肆宣扬这一点，说伊朗人承诺不会这样做。

sentences.en: Now, the president's been making a big deal of this, that the Iranians have promised not to do this.
sentences.zh: 唯一的问题是，他们在 1970 年批准《不扩散核武器条约》时也做出了同样的承诺。

sentences.en: The only problem with that is they made the same promise in 1970 when they ratified the Nuclear Nonproliferation Treaty.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 他们在 2015 年签署奥巴马时期的协议时也做出了同样的承诺。

sentences.en: They made the same promise in 2015 when they signed the Obama-era deal.
sentences.zh: 就在第一页上。

sentences.en: It's on the first page.
sentences.zh: 那里的关键词似乎是“重申”。

sentences.en: The key word there seems to be reaffirMs.
sentences.zh: 重申。

sentences.en: ReaffirMs.
sentences.zh: 然后它还有第二部分，说他们同意坐下来谈谈如何处理伊朗所有的核计划，

sentences.en: Then it's got a second part of this, saying that they agree to sit down and talk about what they're going to do about all of Iran's nuclear program,
sentences.zh: 包括其铀储备、核设施以及继续浓缩铀的计划。

sentences.en: its stockpiles of uranium, its nuclear facilities, its programs to continue enriching uranium.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里设定了一个最低限度。

sentences.en: And they set a minimum level here.
sentences.zh: 最低限度是伊朗同意将他们 11 吨的材料进行降级处理，尽管这里没有具体说明数字。

sentences.en: And the minimum level is that Iran agrees that they're going to take their 11 tons of material, although they don't specify the number here, and they're going to downblend it.
sentences.zh: 那到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: And what does that mean exactly?
sentences.zh: 什么是降级处理？

sentences.en: What is downblending?
sentences.zh: 降级处理本质上就是稀释它。

sentences.en: Downblending means diluting it, essentially.
sentences.zh: 他们的担忧是，我们知道伊朗人拥有大约 970 磅浓缩至 60% 的铀，非常接近制造炸弹所需的水平。

sentences.en: And their concern is that we know the Iranians have about 970 pounds that's enriched to 60 percent, very close to what you could use in a bomb.
sentences.zh: 但他们实际上还有数吨其他不同浓缩水平的材料。

sentences.en: But then they've got literally tons of other material enriched at different levels.
sentences.zh: 所以美国在这里的意思是，你同意至少将其降级到反应堆级别。

sentences.en: So what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我理解正确的话，稀释它会使计划倒退。

sentences.en: is saying here is you're agreeing that as a minimum you're going to downblend that basically to a reactor level.
sentences.zh: 它会摧毁这些材料吗？

sentences.en: So, if I understand this correctly, diluting it sets back the program.
sentences.zh: 这是否等同于摧毁材料，而总统反复说过这是这里的目标？

sentences.en: Does it destroy the material?
sentences.zh: 不，娜塔莉，稀释并不等同于摧毁。

sentences.en: Is it effectively the same as destroying the material, which the president has said again and again is the goal here?
sentences.zh: 这是一档每日广播，不是物理课，所以我不会用细节让你感到厌烦。

sentences.en: No, Natalie, diluting it is not the same as destroying it.
sentences.zh: 你从不让我们感到厌烦，大卫。

sentences.en: This is a daily broadcast, not a physics class, so I won't bore you with the details.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，这一切都取决于他们如何处理这些材料的细节。

sentences.en: You never bore us, David.
sentences.zh: 如果他们只是降级处理，以后总有重新浓缩的风险。

sentences.en: But the fact of the matter is it all depends here on the details of what they do with it.
sentences.zh: 但这里重要的是要知道他们没有承诺什么，那就是将材料运出国外。

sentences.en: If they simply downblend it, there is always the risk that later on they could re-enrich it.
sentences.zh: 为什么这很重要？

sentences.en: But the important thing to know here is what they're not committing to, which is actually shipping the material out of the country.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在 2015 年奥巴马时期的协议中，他们确实同意运出当时库存的约 97%。

sentences.en: Why is that significant?
sentences.zh: 现在，自特朗普总统 2018 年退出该协议后的八九年里，他们积累了更多。

sentences.en: Well, during the Obama-era deal in 2015, they actually did agree to ship out about 97 percent of the stockpile they had at the time.
sentences.zh: 事实是，伊朗人尚未同意将其运出国外，这当然是从防扩散标准来看最安全的做法。

sentences.en: Now, they built up much more over the past eight or nine years since President Trump left that agreement in 2018.
sentences.zh: 说到这一点，总的来说，当涉及到这份协议中与核武器相关的一切时，它与奥巴马达成的协议相比如何？

sentences.en: And the fact of the matter is the Iranians have not yet agreed to actually ship it out of the country, which, of course, would be the safest thing from a nonproliferation standard.
sentences.zh: 你告诉过我们特朗普有多在乎他的协议比奥巴马的好。

sentences.en: Well, to that point, on the whole, when it comes to everything relating to nuclear weapons in this deal, how does it compare to what Obama got?
sentences.zh: 所以，真的更好吗？

sentences.en: You've told us how much Trump cares about his deal being better than Obama's.
sentences.zh: 目前还没有。

sentences.en: So is it?
sentences.zh: 政府谈论了很多他们进行的对话，

sentences.en: Not yet.
sentences.zh: 他们认为在侧面与伊朗达成的谅解，可以解决重大的核问题。

sentences.en: So the administration talks a lot about conversations that they have had,
sentences.zh: 但那场谈判将非常复杂，以至于他们将其推迟到未来几天内开始、为期 60 天的另一组单独谈判中。

sentences.en: understandings they think they have struck with the Iranians on the side that would resolve the big nuclear issues.
sentences.zh: 尽管包括总统在内的所有人都表示，预计需要更长时间。

sentences.en: But that negotiation is going to be so complex that they kicked it to a completely separate set of talks that are supposed to start in the next few days and run for 60 days.
sentences.zh: 所以当政府承诺他们的协议会比奥巴马的好时，

sentences.en: Although everybody, including the president, has said they expect it to take longer.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上是在指望未来的谈判，因为目前情况并非如此。

sentences.en: So when the administration is promising that their deal is going to be better than Obama's,
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: they're really counting on those future negotiations because right now that just isn't the case.
sentences.zh: 你甚至无法比较这些文件，因为奥巴马时期的协议有 150 页，详细说明了如何处理材料、如何检查、

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 必须关闭哪些设施，哪些可以保持开放。

sentences.en: And you can't even compare these documents because the Obama-era agreement was 150 pages of what you do with the material, how you'd inspect it,
sentences.zh: 它极其详细，伊朗人对每一段都进行了争论。

sentences.en: what kind of facilities you have to close, which ones you can keep open.
sentences.zh: 所以这份文件不是那样的。

sentences.en: And it was incredibly detailed, and the Iranians fought over every paragraph.
sentences.zh: 这份文件是关于停火的。

sentences.en: So that's not what this document is.
sentences.zh: 它只有一段话真正直接涉及核计划。

sentences.en: This document's about a ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的大问题是，你在第二次谈判中能得到什么？

sentences.en: It's only got one paragraph that really deals directly with the nuclear program at all.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那还有待解决。

sentences.en: And so the big issue here is what do you get in the second negotiation?
sentences.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡呢？

sentences.en: Okay, so that remains to be settled.
sentences.zh: 这显然是美国为了达成这份协议而绝对必要的事情。

sentences.en: What about the Strait of Hormuz?
sentences.zh: 你本周早些时候告诉我们，政府一直在吹捧海峡将保持开放，且伊朗不会对通过的船只收取通行费。

sentences.en: This is obviously the thing that was absolutely necessary for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在这方面，协议里是这样写的吗？

sentences.en: in order to get to this deal in the first place.
sentences.zh: 嗯，算是吧。

sentences.en: You told us earlier in the week that the administration has been touting that the Strait would be open without Iran charging tolls for ships to pass through it.
sentences.zh: 在 60 天的停火期内，协议里是这么写的。

sentences.en: Is that what's in the deal on that front?
sentences.zh: 让我回头再为你读一遍，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: Well, kind of.
sentences.zh: 这是协议第 5 段的内容。

sentences.en: It's in the deal for 60 days, the 60 days of this ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国将尽最大努力安排商业车辆安全通行，且仅在 60 天内不收取任何费用，往返于波斯湾和阿曼海之间。

sentences.en: Let me go back and read it to you again, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是短期的。

sentences.en: This is from paragraph 5 of the deal.
sentences.zh: 然后同一段提到了与阿曼开启对话，以确定霍尔木兹海峡未来的管理和海事服务。

sentences.en: The Islamic Republic of Iran will make arrangements using its best efforts for the safe passage of commercial vehicles with no charge for 60 days only from the Persian Gulf to the Sea of Oman and vice versa.
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: So, it's short-term.
sentences.zh: 这告诉你，60 天结束后，文件某种程度上承认了伊朗和位于海峡对岸的阿曼，

sentences.en: And then that same paragraph refers to starting up a dialogue with Oman to define the future administration and maritime services in the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.zh: 很可能会想出某种方式来行使他们的主权并收取费用。

sentences.en: So, what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 我怀疑他们会称之为通行费。

sentences.en: That tells you that after the 60 days is over, the document kind of acknowledges that Iran and Oman, which is right opposite it in the Strait,
sentences.zh: 他们可能会称之为保持海峡畅通的服务费。

sentences.en: may well figure out some way to exercise their sovereignty and charge something.
sentences.zh: 所以，这并不完全是让事情回到 2026 年 2 月中旬之前的状态。

sentences.en: I doubt they'll call it a toll.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为那时，战前，通过海峡根本没有任何费用或通行费。

sentences.en: They'll probably call it a service fee for keeping the Strait open.
sentences.zh: 而现在，这份文件似乎暗示，可能的结果是我们回不到战前的状态了。

sentences.en: So, that's not quite returning things to the way they were in earlier mid-February of 2026.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们会想出某种方案，让伊朗和阿曼对一个新的结构拥有监督权。

sentences.en: Right, because back then, pre-war, there was no fee or toll at all to go through the Strait.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And now, what this document seems to be suggesting is that the likely outcome is that we don't go back to that pre-war status.
sentences.zh: 听着，这有一方面是钱的问题，我相信通过海峡的人不想付钱。

sentences.en: And instead, they're going to come up with some kind of scheme where Iran and Oman will have oversight over a new structure.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢在泽西收费公路上付过路费，好吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 我和你一样。

sentences.en: And look, there's one side of this, which is money, and I'm sure the people who are going through the Strait don't want to pay it.
sentences.zh: 这就是生活。

sentences.en: I don't like paying tolls going down the Jersey Turnpike, okay?
sentences.zh: 但更重要的意义在于，这也表明伊朗和阿曼对这个同样被视为国际水道的狭窄通道拥有某种主权。

sentences.en: You and me both.
sentences.zh: 如果你有权对其收取通行费，你可能会认为你有权在未来将其关闭。

sentences.en: That's life.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样的话，那么战争结束时，世界已经发生了巨大的变化，与战前截然不同。

sentences.en: But the bigger import of this is that it also suggests that Iran and Oman have some sovereign rights over this very narrow passageway that is also considered an international waterway.
sentences.zh: 那么我们该如何看待协议中的这一条款，大卫？

sentences.en: And if you've got rights over it to charge tolls, you may consider that you've got the right to shut it down in the future.
sentences.zh: 因为我听到的是，伊朗可能会收取通行费，从通过海峡的交通中赚钱，这对他们来说似乎是一个巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: And if that's the case, then the world has changed in a very big way at the end of this war from the way it was before.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，海峡将开放，这指向了美国从这份协议中得到的另一个显而易见的大好处，那就是战争结束了，油轮可以通过这条水道了。

sentences.en: So how should we think about this provision in the deal, David?
sentences.zh: 这对消费者来说应该是件好事。

sentences.en: Because what I'm hearing is that you may have Iran charging tolls, making money off of the traffic through the Strait, which seems like a huge win for them.
sentences.zh: 我们看到华尔街对此反应强烈。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, the Strait will be opened, which points to this other big obvious thing that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你如何评估？

sentences.en: gets from this deal, which is that now the war is over and you can have oil tankers flowing through this waterway.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这对我们来说是一个巨大的胜利，因为我们回到了接近特朗普总统决定开战之前的条件。

sentences.en: It should be good for consumers.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这就是市场反应如此之好的原因。

sentences.en: We saw Wall Street had a huge reaction to that.
sentences.zh: 油价下跌了。

sentences.en: How do you assess?

sentences.zh: 而且有许多人认为，他们的任务是完成1979年的革命，而这场革命从根本上是基于反对美国的。

sentences.en: And so the president himself, in February, when he was arguing for regime change in Iran,
sentences.zh: 所以总统本人在二月份主张伊朗政权更迭时，

sentences.en: was basically making the case you can't make a deal like this with the existing government.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是在论证你无法与现任政府达成这样的协议。

sentences.en: Today, he wants you to believe that we can.
sentences.zh: 今天，他想让你相信我们可以。

sentences.en: David, we've mostly been talking thus far about the economic payoff, the economic incentives and benefits for Iran in this deal.
sentences.zh: 大卫，到目前为止，我们主要讨论的是这份协议中伊朗的经济回报、经济激励和利益。

sentences.en: There are also geopolitical benefits embedded in it.
sentences.zh: 其中还嵌入了地缘政治利益。

sentences.en: Just walk me through those.
sentences.zh: 请为我梳理一下这些内容。

sentences.en: Well, there are two big ones, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有两个大的方面，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: I mean, the first one is the memorandum basically declares what it calls permanent termination of military operations on all fronts, including Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，第一点是备忘录基本上宣布了所谓的在所有战线（包括黎巴嫩）永久终止军事行动。

sentences.en: And that basically is a rejection of Israel's concern about the threat posed by Hezbollah,
sentences.zh: 这基本上是对以色列关于真主党所构成威胁的担忧的拒绝，

sentences.en: which is, of course, the Iranian-funded and aligned militia group that's based in Lebanon.
sentences.zh: 当然，真主党是总部设在黎巴嫩的、由伊朗资助和支持的民兵组织。

sentences.en: And, of course,
sentences.zh: 当然，

sentences.en: the Iranians wanted that language because now they have a way to pressure the United States over any future Israeli attacks on Lebanon and say they're a violation of the deal.
sentences.zh: 伊朗人想要这种措辞，因为现在他们有了一种方式来向美国施压，应对未来以色列对黎巴嫩的任何攻击，并称其违反了协议。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But not only, you know what strikes me the most about this agreement?
sentences.zh: 但不仅如此，你知道这份协议最让我震惊的是什么吗？

sentences.en: It's the stuff that's missing.
sentences.zh: 是那些缺失的内容。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, think about missiles, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，想想导弹，对吧？

sentences.en: There's no reference in the entire Memorandum of Understanding to opening a negotiation about missiles.
sentences.zh: 整份谅解备忘录中没有任何关于开启导弹谈判的提及。

sentences.en: And yet that was one of President Trump's immediate goals when he announced the opening of a war on February 28th.
sentences.zh: 然而，这却是特朗普总统在2月28日宣布开启战争时立即设定的目标之一。

sentences.en: We heard Secretary of State Marco Rubio come back to it time and time again,
sentences.zh: 我们听到国务卿马可·鲁比奥一次又一次地回到这个问题上，

sentences.en: saying the missile program protected the nuclear program and that Iran couldn't have missiles that can reach Israel.
sentences.zh: 说导弹计划保护了核计划，伊朗不能拥有能够触及以色列的导弹。

sentences.en: And then yesterday in Europe, the president turns right around on this and says, well, of course they need missiles.
sentences.zh: 然后昨天在欧洲，总统对此来了个180度大转弯，说，嗯，他们当然需要导弹。

sentences.en: The Saudis have missiles.
sentences.zh: 沙特人有导弹。

sentences.en: They can't be left without the ability to defend themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们不能在没有自卫能力的情况下被抛弃。

sentences.en: That was not the understanding going in.
sentences.zh: 这与之前的理解并不一致。

sentences.en: And that certainly wasn't the understanding you got from Secretary Rubio, who in tweets in Senate testimony talked about the danger of their missile program.
sentences.zh: 而且这肯定不是你从鲁比奥国务卿那里得到的理解，他在推特和参议院证词中都谈到了伊朗导弹计划的危险性。

sentences.en: Yes, this is a huge pivot, which is, I presume, why you have seen so much anger in Israel specifically over this deal.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个巨大的转折，我想这就是为什么你在以色列看到对这份协议有如此多愤怒的原因。

sentences.en: There's been a ton of criticism.
sentences.zh: 已经有大量的批评声音。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is one of the biggest issues for the Israelis because they're in missile range of the Iranians and the United States isn't.
sentences.zh: 这是以色列人最关心的问题之一，因为他们处于伊朗人的导弹射程之内，而美国不在。

sentences.en: And it's one of the reasons you have seen so much anger from Prime Minister Netanyahu, but not just Netanyahu, about this deal,
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么你看到内塔尼亚胡总理，以及不仅仅是内塔尼亚胡，对这份协议有如此多愤怒的原因之一，

sentences.en: especially because they feel like they were frozen out of the negotiating process during it.
sentences.zh: 特别是他们觉得自己在谈判过程中被排除在外了。

sentences.en: And it's not just the missile issue they're complaining about.
sentences.zh: 而且他们抱怨的不仅仅是导弹问题。

sentences.en: There's no reference in the Memorandum of Understanding that would block Iran from funding Hamas and Hezbollah or other terror groups that have long opposed Israel.
sentences.zh: 谅解备忘录中没有任何条款会阻止伊朗资助哈马斯、真主党或其他长期反对以色列的恐怖组织。

sentences.en: The administration says, don't worry, we'll get to that in the later negotiations.
sentences.zh: 政府说，别担心，我们会在以后的谈判中解决这个问题。

sentences.en: But it's not at all clear that they actually will.
sentences.zh: 但他们是否真的会这样做，还完全不清楚。

sentences.en: And what does the administration say about all this anger from Israel, their primary partner in this war, over these terms?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于以色列——这场战争中美国的主要伙伴——因这些条款而产生的愤怒，政府有何回应？

sentences.en: Well, the most explicit response came from Vice President Vance on Thursday in Washington.
sentences.zh: 嗯，最明确的回应来自周四在华盛顿的万斯副总统。

sentences.en: Donald J.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump is the only head of state in the entire world who is sympathetic to the nation of Israel at this moment in time.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是目前全世界唯一同情以色列的国家元首。

sentences.en: Where he basically said no one has had Israel's back more than Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，没有人比唐纳德·特朗普更支持以色列了。

sentences.en: To some of these cabinet members in Israel who are attacking the president of the United States, the other thing that I would say is that over the last three months,
sentences.zh: 对于以色列内阁中那些攻击美国总统的成员，我想说的是，在过去三个月里，

sentences.en: two-thirds of the defensive weapons that have protected your homeland have been built by American hands and paid for by American tax dollars.
sentences.zh: 保护你们家园的三分之二的防御性武器，都是由美国制造并由美国纳税人买单的。

sentences.en: That he has saved the country any number of ways.
sentences.zh: 他以各种方式拯救了这个国家。

sentences.en: If I was in the cabinet of the Israeli government, I might not be attacking the only powerful ally that I have anywhere left in the entire world.
sentences.zh: 如果我是以色列政府内阁成员，我可能不会去攻击我在全世界仅存的唯一强有力的盟友。

sentences.en: The remarkable thing here is that just four months ago, we went into this war side by side with Israel.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，就在四个月前，我们还与以色列并肩作战。

sentences.en: And we're coming out of it deeply split on the terms to end the war.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们在结束战争的条款上产生了严重分歧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is a very new and confrontational posture toward Israel from the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普政府对以色列采取的一种非常新颖且具有对抗性的姿态。

sentences.en: But, David, just to step back, I want to ask about your sense of who actually comes out on top here in this deal, in this negotiation.
sentences.zh: 但是，大卫，退一步讲，我想问问你，你认为在这笔交易、这次谈判中，谁才是真正的赢家？

sentences.en: Obviously, the war has taken a huge toll on Iran's economy, on its military.
sentences.zh: 显然，这场战争对伊朗的经济和军事造成了巨大打击。

sentences.en: It's caused massive destruction.
sentences.zh: 它造成了大规模的破坏。

sentences.en: But does this agreement set the regime up to come out of this conflict in a stronger position?
sentences.zh: 但这份协议是否让该政权在冲突结束后处于更有利的地位？

sentences.en: Like, did the regime win?
sentences.zh: 也就是说，该政权赢了吗？

sentences.en: Well, in the short term, it's certainly weaker than it was before the war.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从短期来看，它肯定比战前虚弱了。

sentences.en: They've lost their navy, their air force, a lot of their missiles.
sentences.zh: 他们失去了海军、空军和大量导弹。

sentences.en: It may take years for them to go recover.
sentences.zh: 他们可能需要数年时间才能恢复。

sentences.en: But ultimately, there is a pathway here for Iran to become stronger.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，伊朗确实有一条变得更强大的途径。

sentences.en: Now, just because they have the opportunity, Natalie, to get all these economic benefits doesn't mean they actually will.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，仅仅因为他们有机会获得所有这些经济利益，并不意味着他们真的会这样做。

sentences.en: The Iranians have a long record of stepping on their own economic opportunities because somebody somewhere decides to go back to the agenda of making America the primary enemy.
sentences.zh: 伊朗人有长期阻碍自身经济机遇的记录，因为总有人在某处决定重回将美国视为主要敌人的议程。

sentences.en: And that's always the internal battle inside Iran.
sentences.zh: 这始终是伊朗内部的斗争。

sentences.en: But there is no question that they emerge stronger in part because they survived taking on the biggest military power in the world.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，他们变得更强大了，部分原因在于他们在与世界上最强大的军事力量对抗后幸存了下来。

sentences.en: I mean, the Iranians knew they couldn't take the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，伊朗人知道他们无法在正面战场上对抗美国。

sentences.en: military on frontally.
sentences.zh: 军队。

sentences.en: They would have been crazy to do so.
sentences.zh: 那样做简直是疯了。

sentences.en: They set out on a strategy early on of causing so much economic and energy disruption that they believed the United States would be forced to blink firSt.
sentences.zh: 他们很早就制定了一个策略，即制造如此巨大的经济和能源混乱，以至于他们相信美国会被迫先退缩。

sentences.en: And when you heard President Trump say the other day that he didn't want to become Herbert Hoover,
sentences.zh: 当你前几天听到特朗普总统说他不想成为赫伯特·胡佛时，

sentences.en: that he couldn't risk another recession, it must have been heard in Tehran as an endorsement of that strategy.
sentences.zh: 说他不能冒再次经济衰退的风险，这在德黑兰一定被解读为对该策略的认可。

sentences.en: What about how this leaves us here in the United States?
sentences.zh: 那么这对我们美国国内有什么影响呢？

sentences.en: Now that we have the clearest picture of the terms on which this war begins to end, at least, we know that under those terms, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 既然我们已经最清楚地了解了这场战争开始结束的条款，至少我们知道，根据这些条款，美国

sentences.en: has not actually achieved any of the goals that it set out to achieve when this war began.
sentences.zh: 实际上并没有实现战争开始时设定的任何目标。

sentences.en: So is there any argument here that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，相对于战前的情况，有什么理由认为美国

sentences.en: actually gained anything from this relative to where we were before this war started?
sentences.zh: 真的从中获得了什么吗？

sentences.en: Going into this war, President Trump said publicly, privately, that he was following the Venezuela model,
sentences.zh: 在战争开始时，特朗普总统公开和私下都表示，他遵循的是委内瑞拉模式，

sentences.en: that he thought he could just decapitate the country, pick up with the existing government, and turn it into basically a vassal of the United States.
sentences.zh: 他认为自己可以直接推翻该国政权，接管现有政府，并将其基本变成美国的附庸。

sentences.en: He didn't get anything like Venezuela here.
sentences.zh: 但他在这里并没有得到类似委内瑞拉的结果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You've heard President Trump say several times that he had bigger plans.
sentences.zh: 你已经多次听到特朗普总统说他有更大的计划。

sentences.en: He really wanted to go take over the Iranian oil fields, for example, but that the American people wouldn't stand for it.
sentences.zh: 例如，他确实想去接管伊朗的油田，但美国人民不会支持。

sentences.en: That was his way of saying he couldn't do anything that required a ground invasion.
sentences.zh: 那是他表达自己无法进行任何需要地面入侵行动的方式。

sentences.en: So in this competition in which the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这场竞争中，美国

sentences.en: believed Iran couldn't take the pain and Iran believed the U.S.
sentences.zh: 认为伊朗无法承受痛苦，而伊朗认为美国

sentences.en: couldn't take the pain,
sentences.zh: 无法承受痛苦，

sentences.en: at least for the early rounds, it turns out it was the United States that needed a way out.
sentences.zh: 至少在早期阶段，事实证明是美国需要寻找出路。

sentences.en: Well, David, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: Always great to be with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你在一起。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
